text:
incident-bot: paging @eng-oncall: sudden TPM surge for model family `aureus13b` in eu-west-1 — 3x baseline, request queueing increasing, 502s from runtime. Alerting on latency and token backlog.

jordan: acked. taking. any customers flagged?

samira: seeing retries from two big tenants (tenant: acme-inc, tenant: quickdocs). latency ~600ms p50 -> 1.2s p95. droppings in throughput.

lee: looks like requests with long context + funcall chains are the main spike. Funcalls contributing ~45% of tokens.

caitlin: suggested immediate mitigation: reduce per-model TPM for `aureus13b` in eu-west-1 and enable fallback to `aureus13b-compact` for non-SLA tenants.

jordan: agree. plan: (1) set soft TPM cap to 600 for `aureus13b` eu-west-1 (was 2000), (2) lower RPM for noisy tenants, (3) disable funcall for free-tier in region until backlog clears. apply for 10m then reevaluate.

mike: rolling the quota sculpt now. command: ```admin-cli quota adjust --model aureus13b --region eu-west-1 --tpm 600 --note "emergency surge sculpt"```

incident-bot: quota change applied by mike at 1768010065: aureus13b eu-west-1 TPM set to 600 (soft cap).

samira: traffic dropping, backlog decreasing, p95 down to 700ms. retries still elevated from acme-inc, they might need dedicated capacity.

lee: applying per-tenant RPM limit for quickdocs to reduce retry storms: ```admin-cli quota adjust --tenant quickdocs --model aureus13b --region eu-west-1 --rpm 50```

caitlin: disabling funcall for free-tier (non-authenticated) in eu-west-1: ```feature-toggle set funcalls --region eu-west-1 --scope free-tier --state off```

incident-bot: funcalls disabled for free-tier by caitlin at 1768010140.

jordan: good. monitor for 5m. notify SRE if latency or 5xxs increase.

mike: noticing one large bulk-job still open from acme-inc that is bulk-generating. I've rate-limited their pattern-based endpoints to 20 RPM. pinging SE to contact customer.

samira: metrics look stable. estimate 70% of spike mitigated. p95 ~480ms now.

lee: recommend keeping soft cap in place for 15 more minutes and schedule a limited increase if stable. also add an automatic fallback mapping for `aureus13b` -> `aureus13b-compact` for routes without strict latency SLAs.

jordan: +1. I'll draft a post-incident note and coordinate with growth about impacted tenants. who wants to own rollback?

caitlin: I'll own rollback. plan: rollback in 15m if p95 < 600ms and backlog < 200 tokens.

mike: leaving an audit snippet for postmortem: ```{ "action": "quota_sculpt", "actor": "mike", "model": "aureus13b", "region": "eu-west-1", "old_tpm": "2000", "new_tpm": "600", "reason": "emergency surge" }```

incident-bot: incident annotated: severity P2. handoff to eng-sre for follow-up and postmortem.

jordan: thanks team. keeping channel open for updates. ping me if any customer escalations come in. :thumbsup:
